svg.title: macOS · Gallery · the import strip, importing · 1310×800
svg.desc: Mirrors App/GalleryDropImport.swift (GalleryImportStrip, the AppModel.mediaImport branch) under App/GalleryView.swift's header — gallery.svg while an import of outside files is running. Code first, Mac only; Steven signed off the running app on 2026-11-05 and this file was drawn the same day. THE STRIP is gridColumn's third child — galleryHeader, Divider, GalleryImportStrip, the grid — and draws nothing at all the rest of the time: 34 pt of row and a Divider, so the grid sits 35 pt lower while it is up and closes back when it goes. It is the Gallery's on the Mac only (#if os(macOS)). IMPORTING: an HStack(spacing: 10) padded 16 — the glyph (photo.stack for photos, film once the progress names a movie; 13 pt semibold, LL.accent), progress.caption at 13 pt on one line with middle truncation, the bar, and LLFormat.bytes(totalBytes) at 12 pt with monospaced digits in secondary, which is absent until the total is known. The bar is drawn, as Create's import card draws its own: two 5 pt Capsules, Color.primary at 12 % under LL.accent at fraction × width, eased over 0.25 s; it takes whatever the caption and the size leave, never less than 80 pt. The strip shows ANY import of outside files, whichever tab started it — the import is the library's and the Gallery is where its projects appear — so Create's rows raise it too; a drop is simply the one that starts here. MEASURED on the Debug build at 1310×800 (LL_TAB=gallery LL_SELECT=latest LL_GALLERY_DROP=<a folder of 240 photos>, a scratch library), at frame 99 of 240: the row 34 pt under the header's divider with its own divider below; the glyph 13.5 × 14.5 from 17.5 pt inside the column; the caption from 44 pt inside; the bar 490 × 5, its top 14.5 pt down the row, 202 pt of it filled; the size ending 16 pt inside the column's right edge; the first row of tiles 14 pt under the strip's divider, as it is under the header's without the strip. HERE the row is y 101–135, its divider 135–136, the content x 237–983 and the tiles from y 150. The caption counts frames for a batch of separate photos as well as for a shoot (MediaImportProgress's own words — the same line Create's card shows). The tiles arrive in the grid under the strip as each project registers; the sample grid here stands for a library mid-import. When the import ends the strip turns into gallery.imported.svg for six seconds; before it starts, a drop is gallery.drop.svg, and the one question a drop can ask is stills-import.question.svg (docs/import-classification.md §11). THE REST OF THE WINDOW is gallery.svg's, unchanged — the sidebar, the header, the sample grid with its first tile selected and the preview pane that selection raises; see that file's desc for the panes. This family draws a 28 pt title bar and a 52 pt header (divider at window y 80); the build measured here, on macOS 27, puts the column's top edge at window y 32 and the header's divider at 86 — noted in INDEX.md, not corrected in one file of the family alone.
